plugins.prepareCmd: uv version ${nextRelease.version} && PACKAGE_VERSION=$(uv version --short) && python3 scripts/sync_bundle_versions.py ${nextRelease.version} --package-version $PACKAGE_VERSION && task dist && task mcpb && task registry:manifest VERSION=${nextRelease.version} MCPB=dist/lunchmoney-app.mcpb MCPB_URL=https://github.com/juftin/lunchmoney-app/releases/download/${nextRelease.gitTag}/lunchmoney-app.mcpb OUTPUT=dist/mcp-registry/server.json

plugins.publishCmd: PUBLISHER_ARCHIVE=mcp-publisher_linux_amd64.tar.gz && curl --fail --location --output $PUBLISHER_ARCHIVE https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/releases/download/v1.8.1/$PUBLISHER_ARCHIVE && echo 'a06c9096dcb9727c13555b6be26c7effa707b01f06a4c561ba7a3635443cf2cc  mcp-publisher_linux_amd64.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check --status && tar xzf $PUBLISHER_ARCHIVE mcp-publisher && ./mcp-publisher login github-oidc && ./mcp-publisher publish dist/mcp-registry/server.json
